questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All T are P.

II. Some P are Q.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Q are P.

II. Some P are T.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66ffbb8663a3407442a6003a104678c30b23bd09525f447e34569d4ffbd1a24.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some Q are P → True (Some P are Q)

II. Some P are T → True (All T are P so some P are T is also true)

Thus, Both conclusion I and II follows.

questions.question:
By interchanging which two numbers the equation will be correct?

9 – 2 × 4 ÷ 6 = –3
questions.solution:
Equation given: 9 – 2 × 4 ÷ 6 = –3

By interchanging two numbers,

Check the options:

1) 6 and 2

9 - 6 × 4 ÷ 2 = –3

9 - 6 × 2 = -3

9 - 12 = -3

-3 = -3

Hence, option 1 is true so, no need to check the other option.

Thus, the correct answer is “6 and 2”

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All photo are phone.

II. Some phone are yellow.

III. No yellow is red.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some red are photo.

II. Some yellow are phone.

III. No red is photo.

options.text: Either I or III follows and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9466f9da38638298a8c40f723cf2b7e86da9a2aaf0c5de52d7e84689684e5db.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some red are photo → False (No direct relation given hence, false)

II. Some yellow are phone → True (Some phone are yellow)

III. No red is photo → False (No direct relation given hence, false)

Both conclusion I and III are complementary pair

Thus, Either I or III follows and II follows

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘LIP’ is written as ‘40’, ‘GILT’ is written as ‘51’. What is the code for ‘ROPE’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

Add the place value of the digit + 3

LIP → 12 + 9 + 16 = 37; 37 + 3 = 40,

GILT → 7 + 9 + 12 + 20 = 48; 48 + 3 = 51,

Similarly,

**ROPE → 18 + 15 + 16 + 5 = 54; 54 + 3 = 57.**

Thus, the correct answer is “57”.
